articles.title: Johnson & Johnson celebrates innovation in cancer research with 2025 Dr. Paul Janssen Award
articles.mainIdea: Johnson & Johnson celebrates innovation in cancer research with 2025 Dr. Paul Janssen Award
articles.summary: PR Newswire: Johnson & Johnson celebrates innovation in cancer research with 2025 Dr. Paul Janssen Award. Johnson & Johnson today announced Tony Hunter, Ph.D., of the Salk Institute as the recipient of the 2025 Dr. Paul Janssen Award for Biomedical Research. Dr. Hunter is honored for his role in the discovery of tyrosine kinases and protein-tyrosine phosphorylation as mechanisms for the malignant transformation of normal cells into cancer cells and other disease states.
